feature: Detect slow API latency as performance action

result.overview: Performans analizi 1 bulgu uretti. Teknik skor 89, kullanici algi skoru 84 ve toplam skor 86.
timeline_summary: Web: FCP 0 ms -> LCP 10 ms -> TTI 10 ms
API: avg 2611 ms -> p95 2612 ms -> errors 0.0
DB: query 31 ms -> rows 5 -> success True
Akis yorumu: kullanici once web render gecikmesini, sonra API tail latency etkisini hissedebilir.
result.root_cause_summary: En guclu bottleneck adayi backend endpoint latency'si; downstream servis ve cache katmanlari incelenmeli.
optimization_suggestions: Yavas endpointler icin cache, batching veya daha hafif response modeli uygula.
